summary: Plan exhibitor sales, budgets, floor plans and show-site controls. Explore this practical five-day trade exhibition management course.
lede: Trade exhibition management connects an event brief to a workable plan, coordinated delivery and post-show evaluation. For exhibition coordinators, event managers and exhibitor-sales professionals, this intermediate course develops practical skills in setting measurable objectives, building budgets and revenue forecasts, reviewing floor plans and visitor routes, and coordinating registration and show-site operations. You also practise tracking risks, exhibitor pipelines and results with working artefacts to validate against your event’s constraints.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits you if trade shows or exhibitions form a regular part of your work and you need to connect planning decisions with exhibitor service, show-site delivery and evidence of results.
modules: Exhibition Floor Plan and Visitor Flow
Run of Show and Post-Show ROI
prerequisites: Prior involvement in planning, marketing, selling or delivering trade shows or exhibitions is expected. Familiarity with event budgets and exhibitor or visitor workflows will help you apply the exercises. No coding is required; access to Excel is recommended for the budget worksheet activities.
